title: The Night Bitcoin Split in Two ⚡ #Shorts
description:
March 11, 2013: Bitcoin split into two chains.
The new version 0.8 accepted a huge block (block 225,430, over 5,000 transactions). Older versions couldn't read it - their database ran out of locks. Mt. Gox and BitPay paused deposits and the price dropped 24%.
Developers chose the old chain, big mining pools downgraded, and about six hours later the chains joined again. 24 blocks were wiped out, and a $10,000 double spend hit OKPay.

Bug or warning? 👇

Not financial advice. Entertainment and education only.
pinned: Would you have picked the old chain or the new one? 👇

scenes.line: One tweet from Elon Musk sent Bitcoin crashing within hours.
February 2021: Tesla buys one point five billion dollars of Bitcoin.
March: Musk tweets, you can now buy a Tesla with Bitcoin.
Seven weeks later, another tweet. Tesla stops taking Bitcoin, because mining uses too much energy.
Bitcoin drops more than ten percent.
In 2022, Tesla sells about seventy-five percent of its Bitcoin.
One man. One tweet. Who really moves the market?

headline: ONE TWEET / CRASHED BITCOIN
